jobs.description: Register the served cadastral edition's regions in silver.parcel_registry (root ADR-0243; scripts/ops/parcel-registry-cycle.sh): ask which sido prefixes of the edition the registry holds nothing for, smallest first, and bootstrap them one region at a time, starting no new region after 100 minutes so the run ends inside the unit's limit; the next run takes the rest (`unchanged` once every region is registered). Then the readiness candidate (the newest edition newer than the served one whose source and Silver passed, root ADR-0490 §4a): each region no row registers it for yet advances from the newest edition registered there over silver.parcel_lineage (lineage_stewardship derives it; a region whose pair has no lineage waits), the 시도 a link joins read as one region, as joins with only changed parcels written; its rows carry to_snapshot_id, so readers of the served edition fold as of it (parcel_registry_frames.registry_through) and do not move before a promotion. Then, inside the same budget, publish the parcel unit's place ids (root ADR-0481): ask which regions' inputs moved since their last release (registry rows recorded after it, or a 법정동 code change under the region's open PNUs by views.changed_codes), smallest first, and write each one's gold.place_id_registry and gold.place_id_bridge partitions (unit parcel, scope its sido) and its changelog, one Spark run a region; a region that did not move is not read. Daily; it holds every spark slot (the largest region needs the 20g Spark).

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.
